text:
maria: heads up — the curl example in /docs/onboarding/getting-started.md (around the API examples section) is returning a 404 in staging. I ran the snippet and got:
```
$ curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{"error":"endpoint not found"}
```
The shortlink used in the snippet (`/v1/generate`) looks like it was renamed to `/runtime/v1/generate` in the runtime docs. Who owns this page?

doc-bot: link-checker found 1 broken example in docs/onboarding/getting-started.md -> created ticket DOCS-1241 (auto-scan) :mag:

devon: I can take this. Will update the curl example to the canonical endpoint, and swap the shortlink for the runtime example. I'll also add a tiny smoke test to the docs CI so this doesn't regrow.

samir: thanks — please include the exact curl command you used for the smoke test so I can run it locally during review. Also leave a short note in the PR description about why the change is safe for hosted customers (routing backwards-compat handled by proxy).

devon: sure. smoke test I'll add (staging):
```
# staging smoke test for onboarding snippet
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}
' -X POST https://staging-api.redwood-inference.test/runtime/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
# expected: 200
```
PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes snippet fix + ci smoke test + CHANGELOG line.

olivia: pinging release ops: when PR is ready please tag me. We'll batch this into the next docs minor deploy; should be fine to ship asap once CRs complete.

samir: I'll take CR. Quick checklist: verify sample output still matches the example in the prose (i.e., top-level `choices` shape), confirm no dead links left in that page, and please add `closes DOCS-1241` in the PR.

devon: noted. I replaced the inline shortlink and updated the example response to match current runtime output. Also added the smoke script under docs/ci/smoke/onboarding.sh.

doc-bot: CI: docs-smoke/onboarding.sh passed on branch fix/onboarding-curl (run id: 8472) :white_check_mark:

olivia: looks good from ops. @samir when you're happy with CR, we can merge and trigger a docs deploy. I'll coordinate the minor deploy window.

samir: LGTM, just one nit about an extra backtick in the markdown code fence — leaving an inline comment.

devon: fixed the nit and force-pushed. PR updated.

doc-bot: deploy-bot queued docs minor deploy after merge.

maria: thanks all — assigning ownership of that onboarding page to @devon for followups. I'll close DOCS-1241 once the PR merges and the deploy is live. :thumbsup:
